evaluation_kind: development; prior case exposure and handoff scope facts known
baseline: unchanged dev-v2 checker.analyze and physical config; only execution selection restricted to four requested runs
applicability_policy: Baseline direct/indirect support and absence-of-support outputs are provisional. Without established frame-10 support or established absence, return unknown; never substitute reference support labels.
outcome_policy: Provisional candidates, including lift candidates, cannot establish an R1 violation or scope-F exclusion. Baseline provides no validated requirement-level negative evidence. Return insufficient_information with specific evidence gaps, even if no events occur.
coverage_policy: Saved geometry/contact endpoint observations at 20 Hz, nominal geometry lag 0.002 s; not continuous observation or validated camera synchronization. Reference video coverage is not automatically equivalent. Compare binary outcomes only when applicability and outcome are determinate and a validated compatible observation domain is recorded. Retain per-object valid frame intervals and reference reviewed fragments separately.

event_protocol.candidate_policy: Unvalidated candidate types and unresolved origin/scope remain unscorable; retain all original fields, unconfirmed sequences and compound reference subevents. They are not positive R1 predictions.
event_protocol.strict: Inclusive interval overlap AND predicted onset inside annotated onset bracket; unknown onset/offset bounds remain unknown.
event_protocol.assignment: Deterministic one-to-one maximum cardinality, then total inclusive interval IoU, then minimum onset distance, then stable event IDs. Partition phases and scope before matching. No frame TNs.
event_protocol.negative_windows: Retain disjoint reviewed windows; require the entire predicted claim interval to lie in their union before unmatched predictions can be FP. Unknown or uncovered claims unscorable.

metrics: All 20 applicability rows with an unknown column; binary outcomes exclude non-applicable and abstaining/incompatible cases. Zero denominator metrics undefined; positive recall and F1 not estimable with zero reference positives. Unresolved-component-free sensitivity separately, without discarding known non-applicability due to unrelated event uncertainty.
